UAV Avionics and Systems Integration Engineer

Employment Type: Full-time
Sector: Aerospace and Defence

The Opportunity

A fast-growing European aerospace and defence company developing advanced UAVs seeks an engineer to own integration among avionics, sensors, communications, power distribution, flight-control systems and wider aircraft subsystems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define hardware and system architecture for UAV platforms.
  • Integrate avionics, sensors, communications, propulsion, power distribution, flight controls and payloads.
  • Develop architecture, wiring and interconnection diagrams and define signal routing.
  • Establish technical requirements and interface specifications with multidisciplinary engineers.
  • Support assembly and integration and resolve compatibility, wiring and integration issues.
  • Create work instructions, tooling requirements, safety precautions and quality checkpoints.
  • Develop validation plans; conduct functional, integration and environmental tests.
  • Analyse test results and support ground and flight campaigns.
  • Prepare regulatory, approval, user-manual and technical documentation.

Essential Requirements

  • Bachelor’s in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical or a related discipline.
  • Professional UAV, aircraft or aerospace systems-engineering experience.
  • Strong hardware/system architecture and complex hardware/software integration experience.
  • Knowledge of avionics, sensors, communications, electrical systems, signal routing, power distribution, airframes, propulsion and flight controls.
  • Experience in assembly, troubleshooting, test planning and system-level V&V.
  • Strong problem solving and multidisciplinary teamwork.
  • Fluent Spanish and English.

Why Join?

Work directly on advanced UAV technology, own integration across aircraft subsystems, follow systems from architecture through flight and collaborate with international specialists.
